description: This Java source file defines a custom annotation 'Logging' used within the OpenMRS API to control and customize logging behavior for methods and classes. It includes options to ignore logging, suppress argument values, and specify sensitive arguments to exclude from logs.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: An annotation used to specify logging preferences for methods and classes, including options to ignore logs, suppress argument details, or ignore specific argument indexes.

methods.name: ignore
methods.description: Indicates whether to suppress automatic logging for the annotated method or class. Defaults to false.

methods.name: ignoreAllArgumentValues
methods.description: Indicates whether to prevent printing out argument contents during logging. Defaults to false.

methods.name: ignoredArgumentIndexes
methods.description: Specifies indexes of arguments that should not be logged, useful for sensitive data. Defaults to an empty array.
